chapterBreakdown.direct: Most people harden when they feel their ideas or desires have been brushed aside. Carnegie uses that fact strategically. Sympathy is not a decorative niceness here. Sympathy must be precise enough to fit the actual idea or desire in front of you. If it sounds generic, it loses credibility. Accurate sympathy lowers resistance; hollow affirmation does not.
